scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi! I recently submitted an application for a cash-out refinance on my home, and I wanted to check on the status of my loan. Has a decision been made on my application yet?
dialogue.agent: Yes, a decision has been made. Your cash-out refinance application has been approved, and the loan was originated. If you need details about your loan terms or any other information, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know—I'm glad to hear that my application was approved! Could you please tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 9.375%. The total loan costs are $7,121.50. If you have questions about these details or need further clarification, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. That interest rate seems quite high to me—can you tell me if this is considered a high-cost (HOEPA) loan? Also, has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution yet?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. After origination, your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company. If you have more questions about your loan, I’m here to help.

dialogue.user: Thanks for clarifying that it's not a high-cost mortgage. Since my loan was sold after closing, is there anything I should expect or do next regarding the new institution? Also, can you tell me my loan term just to confirm?
dialogue.agent: You do not need to take any immediate action regarding the purchaser of your loan. You should receive communication from the new institution with information about where and how to make your payments. Your loan term is 360 months.

dialogue.user:
Thank you, that covers what I needed to know. I appreciate how clearly you explained each question and the updates about my loan being sold. I feel informed about my next steps, and confirming the loan term was helpful.
